title: The Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 does not limit one of its HTML output rewriting patterns to the…
description: The Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin versions prior to 7.0.19 contain a vulnerability where an HTML output rewriting pattern is not properly limited to its intended markup. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to inject HTML attributes via the comment author name, resulting in stored cross-site scripting (XSS) that executes for any visitor, including logged-in administrators, on pages displaying recent comments.
